milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The crafting table is at spawn-relative (-2, 0, -1). Player must navigate within 4 blocks and face it, ensuring they actually walked to the crafting table rather than just looking in its general direction from spawn. Max distance reduced from 16 to 4 per ValidatorAgent feedback to prevent accidental triggers.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The birch stairs midpoint is at spawn-relative (4, 1, -3). Player must navigate within 4 blocks and face the staircase, ensuring they actually walked to the east corner where the stairs are located. Max distance reduced to 4 to require actual proximity to the staircase.

Uses inventory_has because mining an oak_wall_sign drops an 'oak_sign' item into the player's inventory. In Java Edition, wall signs drop as their corresponding sign item type. The player has a wooden pickaxe but signs break instantly even by hand. This is the most reliable check for a mine task.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The chipped anvil is at spawn-relative (3, 4, 3) on the upper platform (y=4). Max distance reduced to 5 to ensure the player has actually climbed the stairs and is on the upper platform, rather than looking up at it from the ground floor (which would be ~6+ blocks away in 3D).
